refine.name: refines
refine.onEnter: completes the description and the acceptance criteria
refine.onEnd: moves it to To do when its criteria are complete

work.name: implements
work.onEnter: opens a chat in the task's worktree

verify.name: verifies
verify.onEnter: checks each criterion against the worktree
verify.onEnd: waits for your approval, or sends it back to In progress

member.writesNone: No path: only the documents folder

scopeHint.anywhere: Agentry sets no limit of its own on the chats it starts for it. From a terminal it is only what its agent file says.
scopeHint.documents: None of the project's files: only documents in the documents folder, where specifications and reports go. From a terminal it is only what its agent file says.
scopeHint.paths: Outside these paths and the documents folder, the chats Agentry starts for it may not edit. From a terminal it is only what its agent file says.

commandHint.any: When it works on a task, the shell has no limit of Agentry's own. Refining and verifying keep their own tools.
commandHint.none: When it works on a task, it runs no shell command at all. Refining and verifying keep their own tools.
commandHint.listed: When it works on a task, it runs only these commands; a * stands for the rest of the line (pnpm *). Refining and verifying keep their own tools.

member.commandsNone: No command: no shell at all

commandProblem.comma: A command cannot hold a comma: the CLI reads its rules as a comma-separated list.
commandProblem.invalid: A command is one line, without parentheses, and not only a *: leave the list out for any command.

member.responsibilityHint: Goes at the start of every prompt the role gets.
member.fileHint: what you save here the CLI reads as it is, in the terminal too
member.noRuns: It has not worked on a task yet.
member.memoryHint: When it starts it gets CLAUDE.md, the project's memory and the journal. It has no memory of its own.

file.missingBody: {{path}} was deleted. The member stays on the team; write its file again to use it.
file.writeFailed: Could not write the agent file
file.driftedTitle: The agent file says something else
file.driftedBody: Its frontmatter differs from the role in: {{fields}}. It was edited by hand, so Agentry leaves it as it is.

add.title: Add member
add.roleHint: One member per role: the flow gives each column to a role.
add.roleTaken: That role is already on the team.
add.fileNew: Agentry writes {{path}} with the role's instructions.
add.fileKept: The file is kept as it is.
add.responsibilityPlaceholder: What it answers for, in one line
add.existingTitle: Add an agent that already exists
add.newHint: A role, its model and its agent file in .claude/agents/

remove.title: Take {{name}} off the team?
remove.body: Its metadata goes; {{path}} stays on disk, so it still works from a terminal.
remove.failed: Could not take the member off the team

empty.title: This project has no team yet
empty.body: Each member is a CLI agent in .claude/agents/, with its role, its model and what it may write, so it also works from the terminal. Start with the template's team and edit each member afterwards.
empty.bodyShort: Each member is a CLI agent in .claude/agents/, with its role and its model. Start with the template's team.
empty.failed: Could not add the template's team

flow.title: Flow
flow.youApprove: You approve the move to Done
flow.bouncesLine_one: Up to {{count}} bounce; then it waits for you
flow.bouncesLine_other: Up to {{count}} bounces; then it waits for you
flow.notSetLine: No flow saved yet: no role acts on the board.
flow.autoBody: When a task enters a column, the role that answers for it acts. The agents move the cards; you approve the move to Done.
flow.autoBodyShort: When a task enters a column, the role that answers for it acts. You approve the move to Done.
flow.proposalNote: No flow is saved yet. This is what the template proposes for the team you have: save it to give each column its role.
flow.stripLabel: The columns and the role that acts in each
flow.back: if QA rejects it, it goes back to In progress with its comment and the same chat resumes

backlog.does: Refines: title, description and acceptance criteria.
backlog.then: → moves it to To do when the criteria are complete

todo.then: → waits for you to move it or orchestrate it

in_progress.then: → moves it to In review when the turn ends well

in_review.does: Verifies each criterion against the worktree.
in_review.then: → if it fails, back to In progress with its comment

done.does: You approve the move to Done. No agent moves a task to Done.
done.then: → fixed: it does not depend on the flow

flow.bouncesBody: How many times QA may send a task back before it waits for you.
flow.bouncesBodyShort: after that, the task waits for you
flow.modelsHint: Opus for Product Owner and Architect, Sonnet for the rest, as the template brings.
flow.limitsBody: How many runs of the project go at once, and what one run may spend. The rest wait their turn, in order.
flow.costHint: The CLI stops a run that reaches it. Empty: no limit.

activity.title: Team activity
activity.none: Nobody on the team has worked on a task yet.

card.bounceTitle_one: QA sent it back {{count}} time out of {{max}}
card.bounceTitle_other: QA sent it back {{count}} times out of {{max}}

responsibilities.product-owner: Refines the backlog and writes acceptance criteria
responsibilities.architect: Decides the design and reviews it against the codebase
responsibilities.developer: Implements work items in their own worktree
responsibilities.qa: Verifies each item against its acceptance criteria
responsibilities.researcher: Reads the sources and sets out what is known
responsibilities.reviewer: Checks documents for accuracy and clarity
